remarks: Welcome to Fashion Walk, where comfort, style, and convenience come together! Rarely available, this beautifully updated end-unit condo offers 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms and nearly 1,000 square feet of living space. Situated on the second floor of a peaceful, well-maintained community, this desirable single-level home offers added privacy with no neighbors above. An abundance of windows fill the interior with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout. Interior features include newer paint and flooring, along with an upgraded kitchen showcasing new cabinetry, granite countertops, a gas range, and a dishwasher.
